exercise:story-lost-hour-event-01.de: Zuerst habe ich den Schlüssel gefunden.

exercise:story-lost-hour-event-02.de: Danach habe ich mit dem Schlüssel die Anleitung gelesen.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-02.en: After that, I read the instructions using the key.

exercise:story-lost-hour-event-03.de: Nach dem Lesen der Anleitung habe ich das Werkzeug auf den Tisch gelegt.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-03.en: After reading the instructions, I put the tool on the table.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-03.tr: Talimatları okuduktan sonra aleti masaya koydum.

exercise:story-lost-hour-event-04.de: Als das Werkzeug auf dem Tisch gelegen hat, habe ich die Lampe geprüft.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-04.en: Once the tool was on the table, I checked the lamp.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-04.tr: Alet masaya konduktan sonra lambayı kontrol ettim.

exercise:story-lost-hour-event-05.de: Nach dem Prüfen habe ich die Lampe vom Rad getrennt.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-05.en: After checking it, I detached the lamp from the wheel.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-05.tr: Kontrol ettikten sonra lambayı çarktan ayırdım.

exercise:story-lost-hour-event-06.de: Als die Lampe vom Rad getrennt gewesen ist, habe ich das rote Rad gezogen.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-06.en: Once the lamp was detached from the wheel, I pulled the red wheel.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-06.tr: Lamba çarktan ayrıldıktan sonra kırmızı çarkı çektim.

exercise:story-lost-hour-event-07.de: Nach dem Ziehen des roten Rades habe ich die Lampe mit dem blauen Rad verbunden.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-07.en: After pulling the red wheel, I connected the lamp to the blue wheel.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-07.tr: Kırmızı çarkı çektikten sonra lambayı mavi çarka bağladım.

exercise:story-lost-hour-event-08.de: Als die Lampe mit dem blauen Rad verbunden gewesen ist, habe ich das Zahnrad repariert.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-08.en: Once the lamp was connected to the blue wheel, I repaired the gear.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-08.tr: Lamba mavi çarka bağlandıktan sonra dişliyi onardım.

exercise:story-lost-hour-event-09.de: Nach der Reparatur habe ich eine neue Lampe gebaut.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-09.en: After the repair, I built a new lamp.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-09.tr: Onarımdan sonra yeni bir lamba yaptım.

exercise:story-lost-hour-event-10.de: Als die neue Lampe fertig gewesen ist, habe ich die Anleitung wiederholt.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-10.en: Once the new lamp was ready, I repeated the instructions.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-10.tr: Yeni lamba hazır olduktan sonra talimatları tekrarladım.

exercise:story-lost-hour-event-11.de: Nach dem Wiederholen habe ich Emil die Reihenfolge erklärt.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-11.en: After repeating them, I explained the sequence to Emil.

exercise:story-lost-hour-event-12.de: Schließlich hat Emil die Reihenfolge verstanden, und die Uhr hat wieder funktioniert.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-12.en: Finally Emil understood the sequence, and the clock worked again.
exercise:story-lost-hour-event-12.tr: Sonunda Emil sırayı anladı ve saat yeniden çalıştı.

exercise:story-seed-packet-01.de: Voss ist unser Patient. Nimm die Tüte für ihn.
exercise:story-seed-packet-01.en: Voss is our patient. Take the packet for him.
exercise:story-seed-packet-01.tr: Voss bizim hastamız. Onun için olan paketi al.

exercise:story-seed-packet-02.de: Voss hat Fieber. Welche Tüte erinnert Greta daran?
exercise:story-seed-packet-02.en: Voss has a fever. Which packet reminds Greta of that?
exercise:story-seed-packet-02.tr: Voss'un ateşi var. Hangi paket Greta'ya bunu hatırlatıyor?

exercise:story-seed-packet-03.de: Voss soll sich ausruhen. Welche Tüte steht dafür?
exercise:story-seed-packet-03.en: Voss should rest. Which packet represents that?
exercise:story-seed-packet-03.tr: Voss dinlenmeli. Hangi paket bunu temsil ediyor?

exercise:story-seed-packet-04.de: Voss ist müde. Nimm die passende Tüte.
exercise:story-seed-packet-04.en: Voss is tired. Take the matching packet.

exercise:story-seed-packet-05.de: Voss zeigt seine Hand. Welche Tüte passt dazu?
exercise:story-seed-packet-05.en: Voss shows his hand. Which packet matches it?
exercise:story-seed-packet-05.tr: Voss elini gösteriyor. Hangi paket buna uygun?

exercise:story-seed-packet-06.de: Greta gibt Voss einen Rat. Welche Tüte nimmt sie?
exercise:story-seed-packet-06.en: Greta gives Voss some advice. Which packet does she take?
exercise:story-seed-packet-06.tr: Greta Voss'a bir öğüt veriyor. Hangi paketi alıyor?

exercise:story-seed-packet-07.de: Voss hat eine alte Erinnerung. Nimm ihre Tüte.
exercise:story-seed-packet-07.en: Voss has an old memory. Take its packet.
exercise:story-seed-packet-07.tr: Voss'un eski bir anısı var. O anıya ait paketi al.

exercise:story-seed-packet-08.de: Voss nennt eine Adresse. Welche Tüte gehört dazu?
exercise:story-seed-packet-08.en: Voss names an address. Which packet goes with it?
exercise:story-seed-packet-08.tr: Voss bir adres söylüyor. Hangi paket o adrese ait?

exercise:story-seed-packet-09.de: Voss soll seine Karte mitbringen. Nimm die Tüte dafür.
exercise:story-seed-packet-09.en: Voss should bring his card with him. Take the packet for that.
exercise:story-seed-packet-09.tr: Voss kartını yanında getirmeli. Bunun için olan paketi al.

exercise:story-seed-packet-10.de: Greta soll Voss' Bericht prüfen. Welche Tüte braucht sie?
exercise:story-seed-packet-10.en: Greta should check Voss's report. Which packet does she need?
exercise:story-seed-packet-10.tr: Greta Voss'un raporunu kontrol etmeli. Hangi pakete ihtiyacı var?

exercise:story-seed-packet-11.de: Die Tüte steht gegen die Tür. Wähle diese Tüte.
exercise:story-seed-packet-11.en: The packet is leaning against the door. Choose that packet.
exercise:story-seed-packet-11.tr: Paket kapıya yaslanmış duruyor. O paketi seç.

exercise:story-seed-packet-12.de: Voss ist die alte Linie entlang gegangen. Welche Tüte erinnert daran?
exercise:story-seed-packet-12.en: Voss walked along the old line. Which packet recalls that?
exercise:story-seed-packet-12.tr: Voss eski hat boyunca yürüdü. Hangi paket bunu hatırlatıyor?

exercise:story-17-59-announcement-01.de: Der Zug nach Waldruh fährt um siebzehn Uhr neunundfünfzig von Gleis zwei ab.
exercise:story-17-59-announcement-01.en: The train to Waldruh departs from track two at seventeen fifty-nine.
exercise:story-17-59-announcement-01.tr: Waldruh'a giden tren saat on yedi elli dokuzda ikinci raydan hareket ediyor.

exercise:story-17-59-announcement-02.de: Der Zug nach Waldruh um achtzehn Uhr fünf fährt heute nicht. Er steht an Gleis eins.
exercise:story-17-59-announcement-02.en: The train to Waldruh at eighteen oh five is not running today. It is standing at track one.
exercise:story-17-59-announcement-02.tr: Saat on sekiz sıfır beşte Waldruh'a giden tren bugün çalışmıyor. Birinci rayda bekliyor.

exercise:story-17-59-announcement-03.de: Der Zug nach Lindenhafen fährt um achtzehn Uhr zehn von Gleis drei ab.
exercise:story-17-59-announcement-03.en: The train to Lindenhafen departs from track three at eighteen ten.
exercise:story-17-59-announcement-03.tr: Lindenhafen'e giden tren saat on sekiz onda üçüncü raydan hareket ediyor.

exercise:story-17-59-announcement-04.de: Der nächste Anschluss nach Waldruh fährt um achtzehn Uhr fünfzehn von Gleis sieben ab.
exercise:story-17-59-announcement-04.en: The next connection to Waldruh departs from track seven at eighteen fifteen.
exercise:story-17-59-announcement-04.tr: Waldruh'a giden bir sonraki aktarma treni saat on sekiz on beşte yedinci raydan hareket ediyor.

exercise:story-17-59-ticket.de: Du kommst um 18:00 am Bahnhof an und möchtest nach Waldruh. Welche Fahrkarte ist gültig?
exercise:story-17-59-ticket.en: You arrive at the station at 18:00 and want to go to Waldruh. Which ticket is valid?
exercise:story-17-59-ticket.tr: Saat 18.00'de istasyona varıyorsun ve Waldruh'a gitmek istiyorsun. Hangi bilet geçerli?

activity:cafe-a1-first-light.de: Ich möchte einen Kaffee. Erst die Tasse, dann den Kaffee kochen und einschenken.
activity:cafe-a1-first-light.en: I would like a coffee. First the cup, then brew the coffee and pour it.
activity:cafe-a1-first-light.tr: Bir kahve istiyorum. Önce fincanı al, sonra kahveyi hazırla ve fincana koy.

activity:cafe-a1-milk-and-secrets.de: Ein Kaffee. Mit Milch, bitte. Erst die Tasse, dann Kaffee kochen, einschenken und Milch dazugeben.
activity:cafe-a1-milk-and-secrets.en: A coffee. With milk, please. First the cup, then brew the coffee, pour it and add milk.
activity:cafe-a1-milk-and-secrets.tr: Bir kahve. Sütlü olsun, lütfen. Önce fincanı al, sonra kahveyi hazırla, fincana koy ve süt ekle.

activity:cafe-a1-a-glass-of-water.de: Ich nehme ein Wasser. Bitte ein Glas nehmen und einschenken.
activity:cafe-a1-a-glass-of-water.en: I'll have a water. Please take a glass and pour it.
activity:cafe-a1-a-glass-of-water.tr: Bir su alayım. Lütfen bir bardak al ve suyu bardağa koy.

activity:cafe-a1-the-last-receipt.de: Ein Kaffee und die Rechnung, bitte. Kaffee kochen, einschenken und die Rechnung schreiben.
activity:cafe-a1-the-last-receipt.en: A coffee and the bill, please. Brew the coffee, pour it and write the bill.
activity:cafe-a1-the-last-receipt.tr: Bir kahve ve hesap, lütfen. Kahveyi hazırla, fincana koy ve hesabı yaz.

activity:cafe-a2-soup-club.de: Ich esse lieber Gemüse als Fleisch. Für die Suppe brauche ich zwei Portionen Gemüse und ein Glas Wasser. Erst waschen, dann kochen und servieren.
activity:cafe-a2-soup-club.en: I prefer vegetables to meat. For the soup I need two portions of vegetables and a glass of water. First wash, then cook and serve.
activity:cafe-a2-soup-club.tr: Sebzeyi ete tercih ederim. Çorba için iki porsiyon sebze ve bir bardak suya ihtiyacım var. Önce yıka, sonra pişir ve servis et.

activity:cafe-a2-half-past-six.de: Wir treffen uns am Samstag um halb sieben. Zwei Gläser Wasser am Tisch, bitte. Glas nehmen, einschenken und servieren.
activity:cafe-a2-half-past-six.en: We're meeting on Saturday at half past six. Two glasses of water at the table, please. Take a glass, pour and serve.
activity:cafe-a2-half-past-six.tr: Cumartesi günü altı buçukta buluşuyoruz. Masaya iki bardak su, lütfen. Bardak al, suyu koy ve servis et.

activity:cafe-a2-rain-at-the-inn.de: Wir bleiben zu Hause, weil es regnet. Zwei Tassen Tee drinnen, bitte. Tasse nehmen, Tee kochen und einschenken.
activity:cafe-a2-rain-at-the-inn.en: We're staying at home because it's raining. Two cups of tea indoors, please. Take a cup, brew the tea and pour it.
activity:cafe-a2-rain-at-the-inn.tr: Yağmur yağdığı için evde kalıyoruz. İçeride iki fincan çay, lütfen. Fincan al, çayı demle ve fincana koy.

activity:cafe-a2-before-the-soup.de: Zuerst habe ich aufgeräumt, dann habe ich gekocht. Heute machen wir es genauso: Gemüse und Wasser, danach servieren.
activity:cafe-a2-before-the-soup.en: First I tidied up, then I cooked. Today we'll do it the same way: vegetables and water, then serve.
activity:cafe-a2-before-the-soup.tr: Önce ortalığı topladım, sonra yemek yaptım. Bugün de aynı şekilde yapıyoruz: sebze ve su, ardından servis et.

activity:cafe-b1-shelter-from-the-storm.de: Falls es weiter regnet, findet das Fest in der Halle statt. Es regnet noch. Bereite drinnen zwei Tassen Tee und zwei Brote vor: zuerst Tee kochen, dann einschenken und servieren.
activity:cafe-b1-shelter-from-the-storm.en: If it keeps raining, the festival will take place in the hall. It's still raining. Prepare two cups of tea and two loaves of bread indoors: first brew the tea, then pour and serve.
activity:cafe-b1-shelter-from-the-storm.tr: Yağmur yağmaya devam ederse şenlik salonda yapılacak. Yağmur hâlâ yağıyor. İçeride iki fincan çay ve iki ekmek hazırla: önce çayı demle, sonra fincana koy ve servis et.

activity:cafe-b1-a-cleaner-festival.de: Wir sollten vermeiden, unnötig Müll zu produzieren. Zwei Kaffee, aber keine Einwegbecher. Nimm zwei Mehrwegbecher, koche Kaffee und schenke ein.
activity:cafe-b1-a-cleaner-festival.en: We should avoid producing unnecessary waste. Two coffees, but no disposable cups. Take two reusable cups, brew the coffee and pour it.
activity:cafe-b1-a-cleaner-festival.tr: Gereksiz çöp üretmekten kaçınmalıyız. İki kahve, ama tek kullanımlık bardak olmasın. İki yeniden kullanılabilir bardak al, kahveyi hazırla ve bardaklara koy.

activity:cafe-b1-friday-deliveries.de: Die Arbeitszeit beginnt um acht, aber freitags arbeiten wir von zu Hause. Heute ist Freitag: ein Kaffee und ein Brot zum Mitnehmen. Kaffee kochen, einpacken und ausgeben.
activity:cafe-b1-friday-deliveries.en: Work starts at eight, but on Fridays we work from home. Today is Friday: a coffee and a loaf of bread to take away. Brew the coffee, pack the order and hand it out.
activity:cafe-b1-friday-deliveries.tr: Mesai sekizde başlıyor ama cuma günleri evden çalışıyoruz. Bugün cuma: paket olarak bir kahve ve bir ekmek. Kahveyi hazırla, siparişi paketle ve teslim et.

activity:cafe-b1-the-council-break.de: Zu meinen Aufgaben gehört die Planung der Termine. Ada kommt um neun Uhr. Plane den Tisch für 09:00 mit einem Tee: Tasse nehmen, Tee kochen und einschenken.
activity:cafe-b1-the-council-break.en: Planning appointments is one of my duties. Ada is coming at nine. Reserve the table for 09:00 with one tea: take a cup, brew the tea and pour it.
activity:cafe-b1-the-council-break.tr: Randevuları planlamak görevlerim arasında. Ada saat dokuzda geliyor. Masayı 09.00 için bir çayla hazırla: fincan al, çayı demle ve fincana koy.

activity:market-a1-two-apples.de: Ich brauche zwei Äpfel. Ich bezahle bar mit fünf Euro.
activity:market-a1-two-apples.en: I need two apples. I'll pay in cash with five euros.
activity:market-a1-two-apples.tr: İki elmaya ihtiyacım var. Beş avro vererek nakit ödeyeceğim.

activity:market-a1-potatoes-for-soup.de: Ein Kilo Kartoffeln, bitte. Ich gebe Ihnen fünf Euro.
activity:market-a1-potatoes-for-soup.en: A kilo of potatoes, please. I'll give you five euros.
activity:market-a1-potatoes-for-soup.tr: Bir kilo patates, lütfen. Size beş avro veriyorum.

activity:market-a1-five-fifty.de: Ein Brot und ein Kilo Kartoffeln. Das kostet fünf Euro fünfzig. Ich gebe Ihnen sechs Euro.
activity:market-a1-five-fifty.en: A loaf of bread and a kilo of potatoes. That costs five euros fifty. I'll give you six euros.
activity:market-a1-five-fifty.tr: Bir ekmek ve bir kilo patates. Bu, beş avro elli sent tutuyor. Size altı avro veriyorum.

activity:market-a1-paying-by-card.de: Eine Portion Gemüse und zwei Tomaten, bitte. Ich bezahle mit Karte.
activity:market-a1-paying-by-card.en: A portion of vegetables and two tomatoes, please. I'll pay by card.
activity:market-a1-paying-by-card.tr: Bir porsiyon sebze ve iki domates, lütfen. Kartla ödeyeceğim.

activity:market-a2-a-good-exchange.de: Ich esse lieber Gemüse als Fleisch. Tausche das Fleisch gegen zwei Portionen Gemüse. Ich zahle bar mit fünf Euro.
activity:market-a2-a-good-exchange.en: I prefer vegetables to meat. Exchange the meat for two portions of vegetables. I'll pay in cash with five euros.
activity:market-a2-a-good-exchange.tr: Sebzeyi ete tercih ederim. Eti iki porsiyon sebzeyle değiştir. Beş avro vererek nakit ödeyeceğim.

activity:market-a2-the-moving-inn.de: Die Miete ist zu hoch. Ich habe höchstens fünfhundert Euro. Ich nehme das Zimmer für vierhundertachtzig Euro und bezahle mit Karte.
activity:market-a2-the-moving-inn.en: The rent is too high. I have at most five hundred euros. I'll take the room for four hundred and eighty euros and pay by card.
activity:market-a2-the-moving-inn.tr: Kira çok yüksek. En fazla beş yüz avrom var. Dört yüz seksen avroluk odayı alıyorum ve kartla ödüyorum.

activity:market-a2-a-return-journey.de: Ist die Rückfahrt im Preis enthalten? Ich brauche Hin- und Rückfahrt. Mein Budget ist zwanzig Euro. Ich bezahle mit Karte.
activity:market-a2-a-return-journey.en: Is the return journey included in the price? I need an outward and a return journey. My budget is twenty euros. I'll pay by card.
activity:market-a2-a-return-journey.tr: Dönüş yolculuğu fiyata dâhil mi? Gidiş ve dönüşe ihtiyacım var. Bütçem yirmi avro. Kartla ödeyeceğim.

activity:market-a2-the-older-chart.de: Diese Karte ist älter als die andere. Ich suche die Karte von 1860 und gebe Ihnen fünf Euro bar.
activity:market-a2-the-older-chart.en: This map is older than the other one. I'm looking for the map from 1860 and will give you five euros in cash.
activity:market-a2-the-older-chart.tr: Bu harita diğerinden daha eski. 1860 yılına ait haritayı arıyorum ve size nakit beş avro veriyorum.

activity:market-b1-the-short-route.de: Die neue Strecke wäre kürzer, aber die Fahrkarten wären teurer. Ich brauche die kürzeste Strecke und kann zwölf Euro mit Karte bezahlen.
activity:market-b1-the-short-route.en: The new route would be shorter, but the tickets would be more expensive. I need the shortest route and can pay twelve euros by card.
activity:market-b1-the-short-route.tr: Yeni güzergâh daha kısa olurdu ama biletler daha pahalı olurdu. En kısa güzergâha ihtiyacım var ve kartla on iki avro ödeyebilirim.

activity:market-b1-the-cheaper-route.de: Obwohl die Strecke länger ist, ist sie günstiger. Ich habe nur acht Euro und gebe Ihnen zehn Euro bar.
activity:market-b1-the-cheaper-route.en: Although the route is longer, it is cheaper. I only have eight euros and will give you ten euros in cash.
activity:market-b1-the-cheaper-route.tr: Güzergâh daha uzun olsa da daha ucuz. Yalnızca sekiz avrom var ve size nakit on avro veriyorum.

activity:market-b1-nothing-wasted.de: Je weniger wir verschwenden, desto mehr sparen wir. Wir brauchen genau drei Portionen Gemüse, nicht mehr. Ich gebe Ihnen fünf Euro bar.
activity:market-b1-nothing-wasted.en: The less we waste, the more we save. We need exactly three portions of vegetables, no more. I'll give you five euros in cash.
activity:market-b1-nothing-wasted.tr: Ne kadar az israf edersek o kadar çok tasarruf ederiz. Tam üç porsiyon sebzeye ihtiyacımız var, daha fazla değil. Size nakit beş avro veriyorum.

activity:market-b1-costs-of-repair.de: Ich verstehe den Vorschlag, trotzdem mache ich mir Sorgen um die Kosten. Wir brauchen zwei Stücke Holz und ein Seil. Höchstens neun Euro; hier sind zehn Euro bar.
activity:market-b1-costs-of-repair.en: I understand the proposal, but I'm still worried about the costs. We need two pieces of wood and a rope. At most nine euros; here are ten euros in cash.
activity:market-b1-costs-of-repair.tr: Öneriyi anlıyorum ama yine de masraflar konusunda endişeliyim. İki parça tahtaya ve bir ipe ihtiyacımız var. En fazla dokuz avro; işte nakit on avro.

activity:detective-a1-the-workshop-key.de: Der Schlüssel ist auf dem Tisch. Das Fenster ist geschlossen. Das Paket ist für Marta.
activity:detective-a1-the-workshop-key.en: The key is on the table. The window is closed. The parcel is for Marta.
activity:detective-a1-the-workshop-key.tr: Anahtar masanın üzerinde. Pencere kapalı. Paket Marta için.

activity:detective-a1-closed-window.de: Das Fenster ist geschlossen. Die Tür ist offen. Die Lampe funktioniert nicht.
activity:detective-a1-closed-window.en: The window is closed. The door is open. The lamp doesn't work.
activity:detective-a1-closed-window.tr: Pencere kapalı. Kapı açık. Lamba çalışmıyor.

activity:detective-a1-three-recipients.de: Das Paket ist für Marta. Die Fahrkarte ist für Otto. Der Schlüssel ist für Emil.
activity:detective-a1-three-recipients.en: The parcel is for Marta. The ticket is for Otto. The key is for Emil.
activity:detective-a1-three-recipients.tr: Paket Marta için. Bilet Otto için. Anahtar Emil için.

activity:detective-a1-platform-two.de: Der Zug nach Berlin fährt von Gleis zwei ab. Der Zug nach Hamburg steht an Gleis eins. Otto wartet im Büro.
activity:detective-a1-platform-two.en: The train to Berlin departs from track two. The train to Hamburg is standing at track one. Otto is waiting in the office.
activity:detective-a1-platform-two.tr: Berlin'e giden tren ikinci raydan hareket ediyor. Hamburg'a giden tren birinci rayda bekliyor. Otto ofiste bekliyor.

activity:detective-a2-yesterday-key.de: Vorgestern ist die Lampe verschwunden. Ich habe gestern den Schlüssel gefunden. Heute haben wir die Uhr repariert.
activity:detective-a2-yesterday-key.en: The day before yesterday, the lamp disappeared. Yesterday I found the key. Today we repaired the clock.
activity:detective-a2-yesterday-key.tr: Önceki gün lamba kayboldu. Dün anahtarı buldum. Bugün saati onardık.

activity:detective-a2-kitchen-chronology.de: Zuerst habe ich aufgeräumt, dann habe ich gekocht. Danach habe ich den Brief zur Post gebracht.
activity:detective-a2-kitchen-chronology.en: First I tidied up, then I cooked. After that I took the letter to the post office.
activity:detective-a2-kitchen-chronology.tr: Önce ortalığı topladım, sonra yemek yaptım. Ardından mektubu postaneye götürdüm.

activity:detective-a2-the-returned-lamp.de: Otto hat die Lampe zurückgebracht. Ada hat die Karte gefunden. Lina hat das Paket geliefert.
activity:detective-a2-the-returned-lamp.en: Otto brought the lamp back. Ada found the map. Lina delivered the parcel.
activity:detective-a2-the-returned-lamp.tr: Otto lambayı geri getirdi. Ada haritayı buldu. Lina paketi teslim etti.

activity:detective-a2-the-station-before.de: Früher war der Bahnhof kleiner. Heute hat er vier Gleise. Die alte Glocke hängt noch immer dort.
activity:detective-a2-the-station-before.en: The station used to be smaller. Today it has four tracks. The old bell is still hanging there.
activity:detective-a2-the-station-before.tr: İstasyon eskiden daha küçüktü. Bugün dört rayı var. Eski çan hâlâ orada asılı.

activity:detective-b1-a-face-in-the-dark.de: Ich konnte ihr Gesicht nicht erkennen, weil es zu dunkel war. Ich sah eine Person weggehen. Ihr Name bleibt unbekannt.
activity:detective-b1-a-face-in-the-dark.en: I couldn't make out her face because it was too dark. I saw someone walking away. Her name remains unknown.
activity:detective-b1-a-face-in-the-dark.tr: Çok karanlık olduğu için onun yüzünü seçemedim. Birinin uzaklaştığını gördüm. Adı hâlâ bilinmiyor.

activity:detective-b1-waiting-then-leavi.de: Zuerst hat sie gewartet, danach ist sie gegangen. Erst später hat Otto die Lampe gefunden.
activity:detective-b1-waiting-then-leavi.en: First she waited, then she left. Only later did Otto find the lamp.
activity:detective-b1-waiting-then-leavi.tr: Önce bekledi, sonra gitti. Otto lambayı ancak daha sonra buldu.

activity:detective-b1-a-timetable-disagr.de: Der Zeuge behauptet: Der Zug fuhr um acht Uhr. Der Fahrplan zeigt: Abfahrt um 07:50. Beide Angaben können nicht dieselbe Abfahrt beschreiben.
activity:detective-b1-a-timetable-disagr.en: The witness claims the train left at eight. The timetable shows departure at 07:50. Both statements cannot describe the same departure.
activity:detective-b1-a-timetable-disagr.tr: Tanık, trenin saat sekizde hareket ettiğini söylüyor. Tarife kalkış saatini 07.50 olarak gösteriyor. İki bilgi aynı kalkışı anlatıyor olamaz.

activity:detective-b1-two-sides-one-repo.de: Der Bericht zeigt, dass beide Seiten Fehler gemacht haben. Die Stadt ignorierte die Warnung. Das Dorf hielt die Briefe zurück. Jetzt wollen beide Probleme frühzeitig besprechen.
activity:detective-b1-two-sides-one-repo.en: The report shows that both sides made mistakes. The town ignored the warning. The village held back the letters. Now both want to discuss problems early.
activity:detective-b1-two-sides-one-repo.tr: Rapor, iki tarafın da hata yaptığını gösteriyor. Kasaba uyarıyı görmezden geldi. Köy mektupları alıkoydu. Şimdi ikisi de sorunları erkenden görüşmek istiyor.

activity:delivery-a1-left-to-the-pharmac.de: Die Apotheke ist links. Das Paket ist für Ada. Gehe zu Fuß über den Laternenplatz.
activity:delivery-a1-left-to-the-pharmac.en: The pharmacy is on the left. The parcel is for Ada. Walk across Lantern Square.
activity:delivery-a1-left-to-the-pharmac.tr: Eczane solda. Paket Ada için. Fener Meydanı'nı yürüyerek geç.

activity:delivery-a1-straight-to-otto.de: Gehen Sie geradeaus. Das Paket ist für Otto am Bahnhof. Zu Fuß über den Laternenplatz.
activity:delivery-a1-straight-to-otto.en: Go straight ahead. The parcel is for Otto at the station. On foot across Lantern Square.
activity:delivery-a1-straight-to-otto.tr: Dümdüz gidin. Paket istasyondaki Otto için. Fener Meydanı'nı yürüyerek geçin.

activity:delivery-a1-finding-the-post.de: Ich suche die Post. Dieser Brief muss zur Post. Gehe zu Fuß über den Laternenplatz.
activity:delivery-a1-finding-the-post.en: I'm looking for the post office. This letter must go to the post office. Walk across Lantern Square.
activity:delivery-a1-finding-the-post.tr: Postaneyi arıyorum. Bu mektup postaneye gitmeli. Fener Meydanı'nı yürüyerek geç.

activity:delivery-a1-marta-parcel.de: Hier ist Ihr Paket. Das Paket ist für Marta im Café. Gehe zu Fuß über den Laternenplatz.
activity:delivery-a1-marta-parcel.en: Here is your parcel. The parcel is for Marta at the café. Walk across Lantern Square.
activity:delivery-a1-marta-parcel.tr: İşte paketiniz. Paket kafedeki Marta için. Fener Meydanı'nı yürüyerek geç.

activity:delivery-a2-change-in-hamburg.de: Muss ich in Hamburg umsteigen? Ja. Bring Ottos Paket mit dem Zug über Hamburg nach Berlin.
activity:delivery-a2-change-in-hamburg.en: Do I need to change in Hamburg? Yes. Take Otto's parcel by train via Hamburg to Berlin.
activity:delivery-a2-change-in-hamburg.tr: Hamburg'da aktarma yapmalı mıyım? Evet. Otto'nun paketini trenle Hamburg üzerinden Berlin'e götür.

activity:delivery-a2-twenty-minutes.de: Der Anschlusszug fährt in zwanzig Minuten ab. Es ist 09:00. Wähle die richtige Abfahrt und bring Adas Paket mit dem Zug.
activity:delivery-a2-twenty-minutes.en: The connecting train departs in twenty minutes. It's 09:00. Choose the correct departure and take Ada's parcel by train.
activity:delivery-a2-twenty-minutes.tr: Aktarma treni yirmi dakika sonra hareket ediyor. Saat 09.00. Doğru kalkışı seç ve Ada'nın paketini trenle götür.

activity:delivery-a2-missed-connection.de: Ich habe meinen Anschluss verpasst. Der Zug ist weg, aber der Bus fährt. Bring Martas Paket mit dem Bus.
activity:delivery-a2-missed-connection.en: I missed my connection. The train has gone, but the bus is running. Take Marta's parcel by bus.
activity:delivery-a2-missed-connection.tr: Aktarma trenimi kaçırdım. Tren gitti ama otobüs çalışıyor. Marta'nın paketini otobüsle götür.

activity:delivery-a2-bus-out-of-service.de: Wegen einer Störung fährt der Bus heute nicht. Bring den Brief zu Fuß über den Laternenplatz.
activity:delivery-a2-bus-out-of-service.en: The bus isn't running today because of a fault. Take the letter on foot across Lantern Square.
activity:delivery-a2-bus-out-of-service.tr: Bir arıza nedeniyle otobüs bugün çalışmıyor. Mektubu Fener Meydanı'ndan yürüyerek götür.

activity:delivery-b1-if-the-train-is-can.de: Wenn der Zug ausfällt, nehmen wir den Bus. Der Zug ist ausgefallen. Bring Adas Bericht mit dem Bus zur Halle.
activity:delivery-b1-if-the-train-is-can.en: If the train is cancelled, we'll take the bus. The train has been cancelled. Take Ada's report to the hall by bus.
activity:delivery-b1-if-the-train-is-can.tr: Tren seferi iptal olursa otobüse bineriz. Tren seferi iptal oldu. Ada'nın raporunu otobüsle salona götür.

activity:delivery-b1-instead-of-waiting.de: Statt zu warten, könnten wir zu Fuß gehen. Bring Martas Paket jetzt zu Fuß über den Laternenplatz.
activity:delivery-b1-instead-of-waiting.en: Instead of waiting, we could walk. Take Marta's parcel on foot across Lantern Square now.
activity:delivery-b1-instead-of-waiting.tr: Beklemek yerine yürüyebiliriz. Marta'nın paketini şimdi Fener Meydanı'ndan yürüyerek götür.

activity:delivery-b1-leave-earlier.de: Ich schlage vor, dass wir früher losfahren. Die Sitzung beginnt um neun Uhr. Nimm die Abfahrt um 08:00 mit dem Zug und Ottos Paket.
activity:delivery-b1-leave-earlier.en: I suggest that we leave earlier. The meeting starts at nine. Take the train departing at 08:00 and Otto's parcel.
activity:delivery-b1-leave-earlier.tr: Daha erken yola çıkmamızı öneriyorum. Toplantı saat dokuzda başlıyor. 08.00'de hareket eden trene bin ve Otto'nun paketini al.

activity:delivery-b1-ask-for-help.de: Wenn ich an deiner Stelle wäre, würde ich Hilfe holen. Die Brücke ist beschädigt. Hole Hilfe, dann bring den Brief zu Fuß zur Signalstation.
activity:delivery-b1-ask-for-help.en: If I were in your place, I would get help. The bridge is damaged. Get help, then take the letter on foot to the signal station.
activity:delivery-b1-ask-for-help.tr: Senin yerinde olsam yardım çağırırdım. Köprü hasarlı. Yardım çağır, sonra mektubu yürüyerek sinyal istasyonuna götür.

expedition:kigalights-encounter-repair-d.tr: Sorunu anlat, randevu seç, cihazı yanında getir.

expedition:kigalights-encounter-signal.de: Grünes Licht: Eingang offen. Gelbes Licht: bitte warten.
expedition:kigalights-encounter-signal.tr: Yeşil ışık: giriş açık. Sarı ışık: lütfen bekleyin.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-meera.de: Wenn es regnet, lesen wir im Leseraum statt im Garten.
expedition:cedarbay-encounter-meera.tr: Yağmur yağarsa bahçe yerine okuma odasında okuruz.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-ravi.de: Nila sammelt Fragen. Ich antworte nach dem Lesen.
expedition:cedarbay-encounter-ravi.tr: Nila soruları topluyor. Ben okumadan sonra cevap veriyorum.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-anjali.de: Die Lampe ist geliehen. Bitte mit vollem Akku zurückbringen.
expedition:cedarbay-encounter-anjali.tr: Lamba ödünç alındı. Lütfen bataryası dolu olarak geri getirin.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-arun.de: Auf der Hinfahrt kommen Gäste mit, auf der Rückfahrt die Pflanzen.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-dev.de: Latha braucht drei Pflanzen. Ich habe fünf vorbereitet.
expedition:cedarbay-encounter-dev.tr: Latha'nın üç bitkiye ihtiyacı var. Ben beş tane hazırladım.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-latha.de: Die Kräuter sind für die Küche, nicht für die Dekoration.
expedition:cedarbay-encounter-latha.tr: Otlar mutfak için, süsleme için değil.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-farah.de: Meine Gäste müssen vor der letzten Fahrt zurück sein.
expedition:cedarbay-encounter-farah.tr: Misafirlerimin son seferden önce dönmüş olması gerekiyor.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-nila.de: Ein Gast fragt, ob der Garten auch bei Regen offen bleibt.
expedition:cedarbay-encounter-nila.tr: Bir misafir, yağmurda da bahçenin açık kalıp kalmadığını soruyor.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-reading.tr: Kuru havada: bahçe. Yağmurda: okuma odası.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-lamp.de: Geliehen bis morgen. Bitte geladen zurückgeben.
expedition:cedarbay-encounter-lamp.tr: Yarına kadar ödünç alındı. Lütfen şarj edilmiş olarak geri verin.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-plants.tr: Beş tane hazırlandı, üç tane sipariş edildi.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-herbs.de: Für Lathas Küche. Bitte nicht als Schmuck verwenden.
expedition:cedarbay-encounter-herbs.tr: Latha'nın mutfağı için. Lütfen süs olarak kullanmayın.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-questions.de: Fragen sammeln und nach dem Lesen stellen.
expedition:cedarbay-encounter-questions.tr: Soruları topla ve okumadan sonra sor.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-last-trip.de: Letzte Rückfahrt um 21 Uhr. Zehn Minuten vorher am Steg.
expedition:cedarbay-encounter-last-trip.tr: Son dönüş seferi 21.00'de. On dakika önce iskelede olun.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-repair.de: Schalter repariert, Akku vor Benutzung laden.
expedition:cedarbay-encounter-repair.tr: Açma kapama düğmesi onarıldı, kullanmadan önce bataryayı şarj edin.

expedition:cedarbay-encounter-books.de: Ausleihen oder tauschen? Bitte auf der Karte markieren.
expedition:cedarbay-encounter-books.tr: Ödünç almak mı, takas etmek mi? Lütfen kartta işaretleyin.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-minji.de: Jisoo braucht die Leine bis sechs. Danach können wir die Tische aufstellen.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-minji.tr: Jisoo'nun saat altıya kadar çamaşır ipine ihtiyacı var. Sonra masaları kurabiliriz.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-jisoo.de: Ich hatte Hana gesagt, dass die Fläche am Nachmittag noch gebraucht wird.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-jisoo.tr: Hana'ya alanın öğleden sonra hâlâ kullanılacağını söylemiştim.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-hana.de: Wenn Soo früher probt, können wir den Abend gemeinsam nutzen.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-hana.tr: Soo daha erken prova yaparsa akşamı birlikte kullanabiliriz.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-soo.de: Ich kann die Probe vorziehen, solange Eun mit dem neuen Termin einverstanden ist.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-soo.tr: Eun yeni saati kabul ettiği sürece provayı erkene alabilirim.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-eun.de: Für die Aufnahme brauchen wir eine ruhige Stunde. Danach darf Soo proben.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-eun.tr: Kayıt için sessiz bir saate ihtiyacımız var. Sonra Soo prova yapabilir.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-dae.de: Die Dachterrasse gehört nicht nur einer Wohnung. Mehrere Haushalte nutzen sie.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-dae.tr: Çatı terası yalnızca bir daireye ait değil. Birkaç hane kullanıyor.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-joon.de: Die Hausnummer stimmt, aber ich bin am falschen Eingang.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-joon.tr: Bina numarası doğru ama yanlış girişteyim.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-yuna.de: Das Schild sollte Stockwerk und Eingang nennen, nicht nur die Hausnummer.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-yuna.tr: Tabelada yalnızca bina numarası değil, kat ve giriş de belirtilmeli.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-roof.de: Bis 18 Uhr Wäsche, ab 18 Uhr Tische.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-tables.de: Vor dem Aufbau Verfügbarkeit der Dachfläche bestätigen.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-tables.tr: Kurulumdan önce çatı alanının kullanılabilir olduğunu doğrulayın.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-garden.de: Minji Montag, Jisoo Mittwoch, Hana Freitag.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-garden.tr: Minji pazartesi, Jisoo çarşamba, Hana cuma.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-request.de: Frühere Probe möglich, wenn Eun zustimmt.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-request.tr: Eun kabul ederse daha erken prova yapılabilir.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-arrows.de: Links die Treppe hoch, dann rechts zur Dachterrasse.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-arrows.tr: Soldaki merdivenden yukarı çık, sonra sağa dönüp çatı terasına git.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-intervie.de: Mehrere Haushalte pflegen und nutzen die Terrasse.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-intervie.tr: Terasa birkaç hane bakıyor ve onu kullanıyor.

expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-clean-up.de: Nach dem Treffen Tische abbauen und Wege freihalten.
expedition:seoulsteps-encounter-clean-up.tr: Buluşmadan sonra masaları kaldırın ve yolları açık tutun.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-maryam.de: Salim bekommt Wasser bis zehn, danach ist Huda an der Reihe.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-maryam.tr: Salim saat ona kadar su alıyor, sonra sıra Huda'da.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-salim.de: Mein Zeitfenster ist vorbei, aber das Tor schließt nicht.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-salim.tr: Bana ayrılan süre doldu ama kapı kapanmıyor.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-huda.de: Ich habe gewartet. Können wir die verlorene Zeit später ausgleichen?
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-huda.tr: Bekledim. Kaybettiğim zamanı daha sonra telafi edebilir miyiz?

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-khalid.de: Saif prüft den Hebel. Ich kontrolliere danach die Dichtung.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-khalid.tr: Saif kolu kontrol ediyor. Ardından ben contayı kontrol ediyorum.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-saif.de: Das Foto zeigt den Fehler vor der Reparatur. Danach machen wir ein neues.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-saif.tr: Fotoğraf, onarımdan önceki arızayı gösteriyor. Sonra yeni bir fotoğraf çekeriz.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-noura.de: Wir müssen die Änderung erklären, damit Huda ihren neuen Termin kennt.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-noura.tr: Huda yeni saatini bilsin diye değişikliği açıklamamız gerekiyor.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-aisha.de: Huda bekommt vier Pflanzen und bringt morgen vier Töpfe zurück.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-aisha.tr: Huda dört bitki alıyor ve yarın dört saksıyı geri getiriyor.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-hamad.de: Das Tuch ist befestigt. Die Leiter kann jetzt zu Noura.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-hamad.tr: Kumaş sabitlendi. Merdiven artık Noura'ya gidebilir.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-gate.de: Tor klemmt. Reparatur nötig, bevor der Plan wieder gilt.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-gate.tr: Kapı sıkışıyor. Plan yeniden geçerli olmadan önce onarım gerekiyor.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-compensa.tr: Kaybedilen yarım saat daha sonra telafi edilecek.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-repair.de: Hebel prüfen, Dichtung prüfen, Tor testen.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-repair.tr: Kolu kontrol et, contayı kontrol et, kapıyı dene.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-photos.de: Links vor der Reparatur, rechts nach der Reparatur.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-photos.tr: Solda onarımdan önce, sağda onarımdan sonra.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-seedling.de: Vier Pflanzen erhalten. Vier Töpfe morgen zurück.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-seedling.tr: Dört bitki alındı. Dört saksı yarın geri verilecek.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-shade.de: Tuch befestigt. Leiter für Noura freigeben.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-shade.tr: Kumaş sabitlendi. Merdiveni Noura'nın kullanması için bırakın.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-change.de: Neuer Termin wegen Reparatur, nicht wegen einer neuen Bestellung.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-change.tr: Yeni saat onarım nedeniyle, yeni bir sipariş nedeniyle değil.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-well.de: Stand niedriger als gestern. Bitte Bedarf gemeinsam prüfen.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-well.tr: Seviye düne göre daha düşük. Lütfen ihtiyacı birlikte kontrol edin.

expedition:dunegarden-encounter-meeting.de: Erst Fehler klären, dann Ersatzzeit vereinbaren.
expedition:dunegarden-encounter-meeting.tr: Önce arızayı netleştir, sonra telafi için bir saat kararlaştır.

exercise:course-a1-message-exercise-1.de: Hallo! Ich heiße Emil. Ich wohne neben dem Bahnhof. Heute Abend kochen wir um sieben Uhr. Bring bitte Brot mit. Bis später!

exercise:course-a2-invitation-exercise-1.de: Liebe Greta, das Fest beginnt am Samstag um 18 Uhr. Weil es regnen soll, feiern wir im Gasthaus statt im Garten. Kannst du einen Salat mitbringen? Wenn du keine Zeit hast, gib mir bitte bis Freitag Bescheid.
exercise:course-a2-invitation-exercise-1.en: Dear Greta, the festival starts on Saturday at 6 pm. Because rain is expected, we're celebrating at the inn instead of in the garden. Can you bring a salad? If you don't have time, please let me know by Friday.
exercise:course-a2-invitation-exercise-1.tr: Sevgili Greta, şenlik cumartesi günü saat 18.00'de başlıyor. Yağmur beklendiği için bahçe yerine handa kutluyoruz. Bir salata getirebilir misin? Vaktin yoksa lütfen cumaya kadar bana haber ver.

exercise:course-a2-travel-email-exercise.de: Otto schreibt: „Unser Zug hatte zwanzig Minuten Verspätung. Deshalb haben wir den Anschluss verpasst. Wir nehmen jetzt den Bus nach Waldruh und kommen gegen vier Uhr an. Bitte wartet nicht am Bahnhof, sondern am Markt.“
exercise:course-a2-travel-email-exercise.en: Otto writes: “Our train was twenty minutes late. That's why we missed our connection. We're now taking the bus to Waldruh and will arrive around four. Please wait at the market, not at the station.”
exercise:course-a2-travel-email-exercise.tr: Otto şöyle yazıyor: “Trenimiz yirmi dakika gecikti. Bu yüzden aktarma trenini kaçırdık. Şimdi otobüsle Waldruh'a gidiyoruz ve saat dört civarında varacağız. Lütfen istasyonda değil, pazarda bekleyin.”

exercise:course-a2-memory-notice-exercis.de: Am Rathaus hängt ein Zettel: „Die Sitzung wurde auf Dienstag verschoben.“ Greta erinnert sich aber an eine Sitzung am Montag. Sie hat zwei Fotos gemacht: Auf dem ersten steht Montag, auf dem zweiten Dienstag. Beide Fotos zeigen dieselbe Unterschrift.
exercise:course-a2-memory-notice-exercis.en: A note is posted at the town hall: “The meeting has been moved to Tuesday.” But Greta remembers a meeting on Monday. She took two photos: the first says Monday, the second Tuesday. Both photos show the same signature.
exercise:course-a2-memory-notice-exercis.tr: Belediye binasında bir not asılı: “Toplantı salı gününe ertelendi.” Ama Greta toplantının pazartesi olduğunu hatırlıyor. İki fotoğraf çekmiş: ilkinde pazartesi, ikincisinde salı yazıyor. İki fotoğrafta da aynı imza var.

exercise:course-b1-council-minutes-exerc.de: Im Protokoll steht, dass alle Bewohner der Schließung zugestimmt hätten. Greta widerspricht: Drei Personen waren gar nicht anwesend, und sie selbst hatte dagegen gestimmt. Der Vorsitzende schlägt vor, die Liste der Anwesenden zu prüfen, bevor eine neue Entscheidung getroffen wird.
exercise:course-b1-council-minutes-exerc.en: The minutes state that all residents had agreed to the closure. Greta objects: three people weren't there at all, and she herself had voted against it. The chair proposes checking the list of those present before a new decision is made.

exercise:course-b1-route-opinion-exercis.de: Der neue Weg würde die Fahrt zum Hafen um zwanzig Minuten verkürzen. Allerdings führt er durch Gretas Garten, in dem seltene Pflanzen wachsen. Lina schlägt vor, den Weg am Rand des Gartens zu bauen. Das wäre teurer, würde aber die Pflanzen schützen und die Verbindung trotzdem verbessern.
exercise:course-b1-route-opinion-exercis.en: The new route would shorten the journey to the harbour by twenty minutes. However, it passes through Greta's garden, where rare plants grow. Lina proposes building the path along the edge of the garden. That would cost more, but would protect the plants and still improve the connection.
exercise:course-b1-route-opinion-exercis.tr: Yeni yol limana yolculuğu yirmi dakika kısaltırdı. Ancak nadir bitkilerin yetiştiği Greta'nın bahçesinden geçiyor. Lina yolu bahçenin kenarından yapmayı öneriyor. Bu daha pahalı olurdu ama bitkileri korur ve yine de ulaşımı iyileştirirdi.

exercise:course-b1-repair-record-exercis.de: Die Rechnung beweist, dass Elise die Lampe vor der Schließung reparieren ließ. Im offiziellen Bericht steht jedoch, dass sie seit Wochen kaputt gewesen sei. Emil erklärt, dass ein funktionierendes Licht damals gefährlich gewesen wäre: Es hätte die falsche Route bestätigt. Die Reparatur allein beweist deshalb noch keine böse Absicht.
exercise:course-b1-repair-record-exercis.en: The invoice proves that Elise had the lamp repaired before the closure. The official report, however, says that it had been broken for weeks. Emil explains that a working light would have been dangerous at the time: it would have confirmed the wrong route. The repair alone therefore does not prove malicious intent.
exercise:course-b1-repair-record-exercis.tr: Fatura, Elise'nin lambayı kapanıştan önce onarttığını kanıtlıyor. Ancak resmî raporda lambanın haftalardır bozuk olduğu yazıyor. Emil, o dönemde çalışan bir ışığın tehlikeli olacağını açıklıyor: Yanlış güzergâhı doğrulamış olurdu. Bu yüzden onarım tek başına kötü niyeti kanıtlamaz.

exercise:course-b1-storm-report-exercise.de: Obwohl die Straße überflutet war, erreichten die Helfer den Hafen rechtzeitig. exercise:course-b1-witness-call-exercise.de: Ich habe Elise am Hafen gesehen, kurz bevor die Lampe ausging. Daraus kann ich aber nicht schließen, dass sie das Licht ausgeschaltet hat. Sie sprach mit jemandem, den ich nicht erkennen konnte. Sicher bin ich nur, dass sie einen blauen Umschlag bei sich hatte.

exercise:course-b1-interview-exercise-1.de: Ich wollte damals verhindern, dass die Bewohner über die gefährliche Brücke geschickt werden. Deshalb habe ich die Route vorübergehend entfernt. Dass das Amt daraus eine dauerhafte Schließung machen würde, wusste ich nicht. Heute würde ich zuerst mit den Betroffenen sprechen.
exercise:course-b1-interview-exercise-1.en: At the time, I wanted to prevent residents from being sent across the dangerous bridge. That's why I temporarily removed the route. I didn't know the Office would turn that into a permanent closure. Today I would talk to the people affected first.

exercise:course-b1-deliberation-exercise.de: Einerseits müssen wir die Verbindung schnell wiederherstellen. Andererseits dürfen wir die Sorgen der Bewohner nicht ignorieren. Ich schlage deshalb vor, heute nur über eine sichere Übergangslösung abzustimmen. Über die endgültige Route entscheiden wir, nachdem alle Vorschläge geprüft worden sind.
exercise:course-b1-deliberation-exercise.en: On the one hand, we have to restore the connection quickly. On the other hand, we mustn't ignore the residents' concerns. I therefore propose that today we vote only on a safe interim solution. We'll decide on the final route after all proposals have been checked.
exercise:course-b1-deliberation-exercise.tr: Bir yandan bağlantıyı hızla yeniden kurmamız gerekiyor. Diğer yandan sakinlerin kaygılarını görmezden gelemeyiz. Bu yüzden bugün yalnızca güvenli bir geçici çözümü oylamamızı öneriyorum. Kesin güzergâha bütün öneriler incelendikten sonra karar vereceğiz.

exercise:course-b1-procedure-exercise-1.de: Damit niemand übergangen wird, wird jeder Vorschlag zunächst vorgelesen und anschließend zusammengefasst. Danach können Fragen gestellt werden. Wer mit der Zusammenfassung nicht einverstanden ist, kann eine Änderung verlangen. Erst wenn der Text für alle verständlich ist, beginnt die Abstimmung.
exercise:course-b1-procedure-exercise-1.en: To ensure nobody is passed over, each proposal is first read aloud and then summarized. Questions can be asked afterwards. Anyone who disagrees with the summary can request a change. Voting begins only when the text is understandable to everyone.
exercise:course-b1-procedure-exercise-1.tr: Kimse göz ardı edilmesin diye her öneri önce yüksek sesle okunur, ardından özetlenir. Daha sonra sorular sorulabilir. Özete katılmayanlar bir değişiklik isteyebilir. Oylama ancak metin herkes için anlaşılır olduğunda başlar.

exercise:course-a1-checkpoint-exercise-1.de: Hallo Alex! Morgen treffen wir uns um zehn Uhr am Markt. Kaufe bitte drei Äpfel und ein Brot. Danach gehen wir zu Marta. Sie arbeitet heute nicht, aber das Café ist morgen offen.

exercise:course-a2-checkpoint-exercise-1.de: Liebe Alex, leider wurde unser Ausflug abgesagt, weil die Straße überflutet ist. Wir möchten stattdessen am Sonntag ein gemeinsames Essen im Gasthaus organisieren. Wenn du kommen kannst, bring bitte einen Salat mit. Sag uns bis Samstag Bescheid, damit wir genug Plätze reservieren.
exercise:course-a2-checkpoint-exercise-1.en: Dear Alex, unfortunately our outing was cancelled because the road is flooded. Instead, we'd like to organize a shared meal at the inn on Sunday. If you can come, please bring a salad with you. Let us know by Saturday so we can reserve enough seats.
exercise:course-a2-checkpoint-exercise-1.tr: Sevgili Alex, ne yazık ki yol su altında olduğu için gezimiz iptal edildi. Bunun yerine pazar günü handa birlikte bir yemek düzenlemek istiyoruz. Gelebilirsen lütfen yanında bir salata getir. Yeterli yer ayırtabilmemiz için cumartesiye kadar bize haber ver.

exercise:course-b1-checkpoint-exercise-1.de: Die Stadt möchte eine stillgelegte Halle in ein Kulturzentrum umwandeln. Befürworter betonen, dass Jugendliche dadurch einen Treffpunkt erhalten würden. Einige Nachbarn befürchten jedoch zusätzlichen Lärm. Eine Arbeitsgruppe schlägt deshalb vor, zunächst einen dreimonatigen Probebetrieb mit festen Öffnungszeiten einzurichten. Danach sollen die Erfahrungen öffentlich ausgewertet werden.
exercise:course-b1-checkpoint-exercise-1.en: The city wants to turn a disused hall into a cultural centre. Supporters emphasize that this would give young people a meeting place. However, some neighbours fear additional noise. A working group therefore proposes first setting up a three-month trial operation with fixed opening hours. Afterwards, the experiences should be evaluated publicly.
exercise:course-b1-checkpoint-exercise-1.tr: Belediye, kullanım dışı bir salonu bir kültür merkezine dönüştürmek istiyor. Destekleyenler, bunun gençlere bir buluşma yeri sağlayacağını vurguluyor. Ancak bazı komşular ek gürültüden endişe ediyor. Bu yüzden bir çalışma grubu, önce belirli açılış saatleriyle üç aylık bir deneme dönemi başlatmayı öneriyor. Ardından deneyimler kamuya açık biçimde değerlendirilmelidir.
